description: Tired of unclear, inconsistent reports in Power BI? Most dashboards look impressive but fail to explain: Is performance good or bad? Why did it change? What should we do about it? Zebra BI Tables solves this with the most advanced matrix visual for Power BI. It combines the flexibility analysts need with the clarity business users expect: Built-in P&L logic – invert, result, and skip rows with a single click Automatic variance calculations – absolute & relative, no manual work needed Interactivity – drill-down, Top N + Others, and dynamic column headers Four table types – comparison, hierarchical, cross-tab, and calculation tables Dynamic comments & annotations – explain the "why" directly in your reports Responsive layouts – optimized for both web and mobile IBCS® certification – ensures consistent, standardized reporting across teams Unlike native Power BI tables and matrix visuals, Zebra BI delivers these capabilities out of the box: eliminating complex DAX workarounds, manual variance reporting, and inconsistent layouts across teams. Popular Use Cases Financial reporting – income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports Sales & profitability – price-volume-mix analysis, product & brand portfolio performance Operations – cost centers, inventory, and working capital management HR & management dashboards – employee performance, headcount, and resource planning Why…
